hint.lead: a hint you can read out:

decode.countIntro: The number they found is {key}. Everyone claps or hops {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}. Count out loud together!
decode.numberIntro: Every number in this code hides a letter. Turn the numbers into a word with the key, then see which word fits the gap in the clue.
decode.shiftIntro: Every letter in this code moved forward in the alphabet. Move each one back with the key, then see which words fit the gap in the clue.
decode.wrong: Not quite. Check the letters once more.
decode.keyNumbers: the key: letter, then its number
decode.keyShift: the key: coded letter, then the real one
decode.parentNote: Let them work it out on paper. The buttons are the check.

strike.askCrossOut: Who can we cross out now?
strike.askPointsAt: Who does this clue point at?
strike.wrong: Read the clue again: who does it talk about?
